paragraphs: I am an Applied Scientist and AI/ML Engineer with 7+ years of experience in production machine learning, predictive analytics and intelligent automation across energy systems, building systems and data-driven business applications.

At the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NREL), I led the ML surrogates behind the DOE Section 179D Web Calculator. They were trained on hundreds of thousands of EnergyPlus simulations across 16 U.S. climate zones and reach 1.1–3.3% average CVRMSE.
My recent work covers LLM and agentic AI workflows with deterministic evaluation, MLOps and model observability, and deep reinforcement learning for grid-interactive building control.
I have 20+ peer-reviewed publications (401 citations, h-index 11) and one U.S. patent.
